title: MSP-MVS Multi-granularity Segmentation Prior Guided Multi-View Stereo

predicted_errors.error_location: Abstract and Introduction ('Therefore, we propose TSAR-MVS...' and 'In summary, our contributions...')
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The title/abstract describe MSP-MVS with multi-granularity segmentation prior, anchor equidistribution, and iterative local search optimization. However, the Introduction proposes 'TSAR-MVS, a generalized post-processing MVS method that sequentially applies confidence-based outliers filtering, superpixel-based local refinement, and feature-based area generation', and the contribution list repeats the TSAR-MVS components (joint hypothesis filter, iterative correlation refinement, textureless-aware segmentation) instead of the MSP-MVS components. This directly contradicts the paper's stated method and contributions.

predicted_errors.error_location: Introduction vs Related Work: 'TSAR-MVS (Yuan et al. 2024b)' cited as prior work and then 'we propose TSAR-MVS'
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The related-work paragraph lists 'TSAR-MVS (Yuan et al. 2024b)' among existing superpixel-planarization methods, but earlier the text says 'we propose TSAR-MVS'. The same method name cannot both be a cited prior work and the paper's proposed contribution; this is an internal contradiction indicating copy-paste from the TSAR-MVS manuscript.

predicted_errors.error_location: Section introducing Semantic-SAM ('we adopt the Semantic-SAM...') and references (Kirillov et al. 2023)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text repeatedly attributes Semantic-SAM to Kirillov et al. 2023, but that reference is 'Segment Anything' (SAM). Semantic-SAM is a distinct model/paper ('Segment and Recognize Anything at Any Granularity') and is not present in the reference list.

predicted_errors.error_location: Related Work: 'To reduce memory, Cas-MVSNet (Yang et al. 2020) adopted a coarse-to-fine strategy...'
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Yang et al. 2020 is not Cas-MVSNet; the cited reference 'Cost Volume Pyramid Based Depth Inference for Multi-View Stereo' is CVP-MVSNet. Cas-MVSNet is a different method/paper. Thus the named method is misattributed to the wrong reference.

predicted_errors.error_location: Introduction, consecutive paragraphs beginning 'Due to the absence of depth edge as constraints...' and 'Since APD-MVS lacks depth edge guidance...'
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The same rationale about APD-MVS skipping depth edges and Semantic-SAM providing multi-granularity segmentation is duplicated in nearly identical consecutive paragraphs. One version says anchors are 'selected within green heterogeneous areas', referencing a visual/figure color not defined in the text. This appears to be an incomplete merge/editing error.
